categories.rationale: Noticeably speeds up deterministic fuzz coverage analysis by skipping expensive report rendering for identical profile data. In review testing, running `process_message` dropped from 1h50m to 25m48s, though the tool is specialized to fuzz contributors rather than a general-purpose developer tool.
